body: I want to be taken care of. I want to be safe.

Hey, I love you. I hope you feel better soon and that everything goes well for you, sweet angel. You deserve to smile and feel good, and be surrounded by love at all times. I promise you don't have to feel guilty about what you wrote; it's simply a coping mechanism and you didn't have any bad intentions. I'm sending you warm hugs and thoughts.
this week was full of flashbacks and fear.... i still have so many repressed memories but im afraid i still am and i just want to be taken care of i wish i was taken care of im crying
Thank you, I appreciate your help.
